s_system.text: Inbox and the four PARA folders keep one colour, one mark and one place, everywhere; P A R A reads down the list, Archives as a lilac A. Formats: what Bower reads, what the app shows, what is only kept, said at Add time. Colour is only for these five; file kinds are grey with a short badge. Bower's note keeps the v3 colour code by where each line comes from.

t_find.text: Find: the Notes tab and search

s_find.text: One explorer on the phone: the Notes tab. The top-left folder menu goes; its good parts (Pinned, the five folders with their meaning) move here. Opening Notes from a note opens it at that note. Search finds folders, notes and files, forgives typos, and filters by kind and folder.

t_folder.text: A folder: list, grid, quick look, move

s_folder.text: A folder is a list or a grid, remembered per folder. Sort and kind filter on one row. All · Originals · By Bower shows everything, only what you added or wrote, or only what Bower wrote with its key facts; a small Bower tag marks what Bower wrote. An original and Bower's note on it share one row. Holding a tile gives a quick look. Move to… stays Bower's job: a folder picker, then now or with the next tidy-up.

t_view.text: Seeing a thing: notes, photos, spreadsheets

s_view.text: Bower's note is back at the top of a note, as the v3 board drew it, and on a file's own screen when Bower has something to say about it. Every file says what it is. A copy says it is a copy and links to the original. Next and previous walk the folder.

t_read.text: What Bower reads: details and long documents

s_read.text: Bower reads details from what it files (a listing, an offer, a receipt) as properties, grouped and labelled, each with where it came from; they fold under Details, with four key facts on top. A folder of the same kind becomes a table to compare. A long note keeps a short gist on top and adds Bower on a section only where it has something to say; a long PDF gets Where to look.

s_desk.text: Desktop: tree, folder and preview side by side. Opening anything highlights it in the tree and opens the folders above it. Space for a quick look, arrows to move, Backspace up a folder. Search can be kept to the folder you are in.

t_story.text: The story: Bower joins the dots nobody asked it to

s_story.text: Sign-up asks two general questions, all optional; Bower never asks for a CV. Over the months Alex adds everyday papers: an offer letter, a Cycle to Work agreement. When she adds flat listings with three words, Bower times each flat by bike to her office on its own, and says which notes it joined.
